timeline.event: Nightly reconciliation run completes for all 14 clinics
Exceptions report generated with 97 skipped slots and 3 merged slots
Clinic staff audit exceptions report; 85% of skipped slots are attributed to template rule conflicts
Root cause investigation initiated; template rule conflict is ruled out as primary driver

causal_chain.event: Calendar reconciliation fails to detect overlapping slots due to missing alert for slot merge
causal_chain.preventing_control: Slot merge detection rule in scheduling service
causal_chain.missing_alert: Merge alert triggered when two appointments are scheduled within 30 minutes of each other
causal_chain.falsifiable_evidence: If the merge alert had been triggered and logged, the skipped slot would have been flagged as a conflict, not a skip

causal_chain.event: The merge detection rule is disabled in clinic_7 due to a configuration override
causal_chain.preventing_control: Configuration override for clinic_7 scheduling rules
causal_chain.missing_alert: No alert generated when slot merge occurs in clinic_7
causal_chain.falsifiable_evidence: If the configuration override had been applied to all clinics, or if the rule were enabled and active, the merge would have triggered an alert and been recorded

causal_chain.event: The disabled rule results in unreported slot merges that are not reconciled during nightly run
causal_chain.missing_alert: No reconciliation of merged slots due to absence of merge alert
causal_chain.falsifiable_evidence: If the merge detection had been active and alerts generated, the reconciliation would have identified and resolved the conflict

blast_radius.calculated_impact: The failure affects all clinics, with clinic_7 contributing 85% of skipped slots due to its disabled merge detection rule
blast_radius.reconciliation_reconciliation_check: All reconciliation runs must include a merge-detection alert check in the nightly job output

remediation.action: Re-enable merge detection rule for all clinics in scheduling service configuration
remediation.owner: Scheduling Service Lead, Dr. Elena Martinez
remediation.verification_step_immediate: Run reconciliation on clinic_7 and verify that a merge alert is generated when two appointments are scheduled within 30 minutes of each other
remediation.verification_step_long_term: Run nightly reconciliation across all clinics for seven consecutive days; validate that no skipped or merged slots appear in exceptions reports
remediation.residual_risk: If the practice-management export still contains double-booking errors, merge detection may be bypassed during data ingestion
remediation.follow_up_diagnostic: Verify that the practice-management export from clinic_7 is validated against a clean calendar before reconciliation; this check has not yet been run
remediation.regression_hook: The merge alert must appear in the nightly reconciliation log output for any clinic with overlapping slots

remediation.action: Implement mandatory template rule review board approval for all changes to slot merge detection logic
remediation.owner: Template Review Board Chair, Mr. Raj Patel
remediation.verification_step_immediate: Review and approve the current merge detection rule change in the template governance system
remediation.verification_step_long_term: Require that any future changes to slot merge rules must be reviewed by the board before deployment
remediation.residual_risk: The review process may introduce delays, but no new failures are expected under normal operation
remediation.follow_up_diagnostic: Monitor for new exceptions reports with skipped or merged slots over a 30-day period; this check has not yet been run
remediation.regression_hook: All rule changes must be logged and reviewed in the template governance system

notes: The artifact does not include clinical content, message content, or identifiers. All data is derived from supplied facts. The double-booking defect in clinic_7 is acknowledged but ruled out as a direct cause of skipped slots; it is considered a contributing factor only if merge detection fails to catch the conflict. This analysis excludes any discussion of patient communication channel performance beyond slot reconciliation. No new top-level keys are introduced.
